title: "Hippocampal_Volume_Analysis"
output: html_notebook
---


# Overview

# This notebook analyzes bilateral hippocampal volume across healthy controls and individuals with opioid use disorder, including participants with and without a history of non-fatal opioid overdose.

# Participant-level data are not included in this repository.

# Data Preparation

## Load packages

library(car)
library(emmeans)
library(effectsize)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx)
library(ggbeeswarm)

options(pillar.sigfig = 6)

# Load data
# Set this to the location of the dataset.
# data_path <- "/path/to/data.xlsx"

dat <- read.xlsx(
  data_path,
  sheet = "NA",
  na.strings = "NA"
)


# Define variables 

dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    Subject_ID = as.factor(Subject_ID),
    Grp = factor(
      Grp,
      levels = c("HC", "OUD-NOD", "OUD-OD", "OUD (other)")
    ),
    Grp_OUD_All = factor(
      Grp_OUD_All,
      levels = c("HC", "OUD")
    ),
    Sex = as.factor(Sex),
    Race = factor(
      Race,
      levels = c("White", "Black", "Asian", "Other")
    ),
    Ethnicity = factor(
      Ethnicity,
      levels = c("Hispanic", "Non-Hispanic")
    ),
    Medication = factor(
      Medication,
      levels = c("Methadone", "Buprenorphine", "No medication")
    )
  )

# Define scanner

# The hippocampal volume dataset includes scans acquired on Siemens Trio and Prisma scanners. Scanner was included as a covariate in a sensitivity analysis.

dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    Scanner = case_when(
      Study %in% c("CURE", "XRNT") ~ "TRIO",
      TRUE ~ "PRISMA"
    ),
    Scanner = factor(Scanner)
  )

# Primary Hippocampal Volume Analysis
# Three-group ANCOVA

# The primary analysis compares hippocampal volume across:

# Healthy controls (HC)
# OUD without a history of non-fatal overdose (OUD-NOD)
# OUD with a history of non-fatal overdose (OUD-OD)

# Age, sex, and total intracranial volume (ICV) are included as covariates.

# Participants classified as "OUD (other)" are excluded from this three-group analysis.

primary_dat <- dat %>%
  filter(Grp != "OUD (other)") %>%
  droplevels()

primary_model <- lm(
  BiHPC_Vol ~ Grp + Age + Sex + ICV_cm3,
  data = primary_dat
)

car::Anova(
  primary_model,
  type = 3
)

# Effect size

primary_anova <- car::Anova(
  primary_model,
  type = 3
)

primary_effect <- effectsize::eta_squared(
  primary_anova,
  partial = TRUE
)

primary_effect


# Estimated marginal means

# Estimated marginal means provide group means adjusted for age, sex, and ICV.

primary_emmeans <- emmeans(
  primary_model,
  ~ Grp
)

primary_emmeans

# Planned contrasts

# Two planned comparisons were specified:

# 1. Healthy controls vs. the combined OUD groups
# 2. OUD-NOD vs. OUD-OD

# Sidak correction was applied to the planned comparisons.

primary_contrasts <- contrast(
  primary_emmeans,
  method = list(
    "HC vs OUD" = c(1, -0.5, -0.5),
    "OUD-NOD vs OUD-OD" = c(0, 1, -1)
  ),
  adjust = "sidak"
)

primary_contrasts

# Confidence intervals

confint(primary_contrasts)

# Effect sizes for planned contrasts

eff_size(
  primary_contrasts,
  sigma = sigma(primary_model),
  edf = df.residual(primary_model),
  method = "identity"
)

# Figure Generation

# The figure displays adjusted hippocampal volume by group while retaining individual participant observations.

# Remove the effects of the continuous and categorical covariates while retaining the group-specific estimated marginal means.

covariate_model <- lm(
  BiHPC_Vol ~ Age + Sex + ICV_cm3,
  data = primary_dat
)

plot_data <- primary_dat %>%
  mutate(
    adjusted_volume = residuals(covariate_model)
  )

group_means <- as.data.frame(primary_emmeans) %>%
  select(Grp, emmean)

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  left_join(group_means, by = "Grp") %>%
  mutate(
    adjusted_volume = adjusted_volume -
      mean(adjusted_volume, na.rm = TRUE) +
      emmean
  )

hippocampal_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(x = Grp, y = adjusted_volume)
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(color = Grp),
    width = 0.5,
    linewidth = 1,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  stat_boxplot(
    geom = "errorbar",
    aes(color = Grp),
    width = 0.5,
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_dotplot(
    aes(fill = Sex),
    color = "gray50",
    binaxis = "y",
    stackdir = "center",
    stackgroups = TRUE,
    binpositions = "all",
    dotsize = 0.8
  ) +
  theme_linedraw() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Hippocampal volume (mm³)",
    title = "Hippocampal Volume Across Groups"
  ) +
  guides(
    color = "none"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    )
  )

hippocampal_plot

# Save the figure:

ggsave(
  "Figures/Hippocampal_Volumes.png",
  plot = hippocampal_plot,
  width = 6,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)

# Scanner-Adjusted Sensitivity Analysis

# A sensitivity analysis was performed to determine whether the hippocampal volume findings persisted after additionally accounting for MRI scanner.

# The revised model includes:

# 1. Group
# 2. Age
# 3. Sex
# 4. ICV
# 5. Scanner

# Three-group analysis

scanner_model_3group <- lm(
  BiHPC_Vol ~ Grp + Age + Sex + ICV_cm3 + Scanner,
  data = primary_dat
)

car::Anova(
  scanner_model_3group,
  type = 3
)


# Estimated marginal means

scanner_emmeans <- emmeans(
  scanner_model_3group,
  ~ Grp
)

scanner_emmeans

# Planned contrasts

scanner_contrasts <- contrast(
  scanner_emmeans,
  method = list(
    "HC vs OUD" = c(1, -0.5, -0.5),
    "OUD-NOD vs OUD-OD" = c(0, 1, -1)
  ),
  adjust = "sidak"
)

scanner_contrasts

confint(scanner_contrasts)

eff_size(
  scanner_contrasts,
  sigma = sigma(scanner_model_3group),
  edf = df.residual(scanner_model_3group),
  method = "identity"
)

# Two-group HC vs. OUD analysis

#T he OUD-NOD and OUD-OD groups are combined for a two-group comparison with healthy controls.

scanner_model_2group <- lm(
  BiHPC_Vol ~ Grp_OUD_All + Age + Sex + ICV_cm3 + Scanner,
  data = dat %>% droplevels()
)

car::Anova(
  scanner_model_2group,
  type = 3
)

scanner_emmeans_2group <- emmeans(
  scanner_model_2group,
  ~ Grp_OUD_All
)

scanner_emmeans_2group

contrast(
  scanner_emmeans_2group,
  method = list(
    "HC vs OUD" = c(1, -1)
  )
)

# Sex × Group Analysis

# A separate model tests whether the relationship between OUD group and hippocampal volume differs by sex.

# Three-group interaction

sex_model_3group <- lm(
  BiHPC_Vol ~ Grp * Sex + Age + ICV_cm3,
  data = primary_dat
)

car::Anova(
  sex_model_3group,
  type = 3
)

# Estimated marginal means

sex_emmeans <- emmeans(
  sex_model_3group,
  ~ Grp | Sex
)

sex_emmeans

# Joint test of group differences within sex

joint_tests(
  sex_emmeans
)

# Two-group interaction

# A corresponding model examines the Sex × OUD interaction after combining the two OUD groups.

sex_model_2group <- lm(
  BiHPC_Vol ~ Grp_OUD_All * Sex + Age + ICV_cm3,
  data = dat %>% droplevels()
)

car::Anova(
  sex_model_2group,
  type = 3
)

# Summary

# The analyses above reproduce the hippocampal volume statistical framework used in the study, including the primary three-group ANCOVA, planned group contrasts, scanner-adjusted sensitivity analyses, and sex-by-group analyses.

#Participant-level data are excluded from this repository.
